pages.text: With a $(l:multiblock_machines/fabricator)Fabricator$(/l) and a $(l:multiblock_machines/reaction_chamber)Reaction Chamber$(/l) you have access to new high-tech weapons and armors.
The reaction chamber can process titanium ore needed for tier 3 armors. Also it is possible to enrich uranium for nuclear weapons. The fabricator produces energy cells and other items needed.
pages.title: Advanced Processing

pages.text: If you acquire a nether star you can craft the 'anti-gravity device' allowing you to use creative flight when worn.
pages.title: The Power of Flight
